subject: Interactive line drawing using mouse similar to impoly of Matlab

messages.author: 4d0b039093f918a4
messages.subject: Interactive line drawing using mouse similar to impoly of Matlab
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to implement the functionality of impoly of Matlab in R Shiny.  I want to draw a interactive line segment based on mouse clicks.
I tried to use the plotOutput("plot", click = "plot_click") function along with observe and isolate, but when I try to draw using the render plot, I get the flickering effects on the plot. Tried to use dev.hold() and dev.flush(), but still the problem remains.

Any suggestions please?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Interactive line drawing using mouse similar to impoly of Matlab
parts:
By the flickering effects, do you mean the slight fading that happens to all outputs as they recalculate? If so, you can disable that using the snippet in this post:
https://groups.google.com/d/msg/shiny-discuss/9faA5OUm2Hc/gTaWvM-tqvAJ
